blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The office of Cagayan de Oro Rep. Lordan Suan on Friday debunked false information circulating online claiming that the lawmaker was proposing a shift to a parliamentary form of government and the postponement of elections. In a statement, Suan’s office said the circulating videos and photos were “fabricated and digitally manipulated,” with the lawmaker categorically dismissing the claims as fake. READ: Rep. Suan disowns fake post claiming ayuda after Duterte impeachment “The deliberate spread of false information is a malicious attempt to tarnish Congressman Suan’s reputation and mislead the Filipino people,” his office said. “Such tactics have no […]...
